text:
Mia: Quick WFH microgarden update — week 1 and my desk jungle is officially out of control. Plants are thriving, my keyboard less so. Uploaded a pic: microgarden_week1.jpg :seedling:
Devin: Omg pics pls :)
Mia: (uploaded) — microgarden_week1.jpg :camera_flash:
Samir: Wow that's glorious. Have you named them yet? :laughing:
Mia: Not yet. Temp name: 'Sir Sprout' :crown:
Olivia: Heads up — that humidity looks risky. If RH stays >60% you can get mold. Put a hygrometer near the pots and increase airflow.
Mia: Good call. My cheap sensor reads `RH 68%` and `22°C` right now. Keyboard is sticky. :sob:
Raj: Two quick things: raise the laptop on a riser, and scatter a few silica packets around the soil (no direct contact). USB fan on low helps with evaporation.
Mia: Already propped the laptop on a stack of books. Trying the silica tonight. Thanks!
Samir: If it gets worse try semi-hydro or a tray to catch spills. Also consider swapping to succulents if you want lower humidity.
Olivia: If anyone wants, I have a spare USB hygrometer I can post to you — DM me. :thumbsup:
Devin: Poll time: name the biggest pothos 'Redwood' or 'Inference'? :thinking_face:
Mia: Haha 'Inference' wins by default. :seedling::tada:
garden-bot: Reminder: photos in #random are great! Please avoid sharing screenshots with customer data. :robot_face:
Mia: Thanks for the tips y'all — fan goes on tonight. Will post a before/after update tomorrow. Peace out! :wave:
